nodes.description: Caller-supplied address; drives authorization checks, player registration and payout destinations.
block.timestamp (now / block.number+now); miner-influenced value used in randomness and event records.
address private owner, initialized to msg.sender; controls setNewAdmin.
address private admin, initialized to msg.sender; gate for isAdmin modifier and bet ownership fallback.
bool game switch toggled by activate/close and required by isActivated modifier.
Accumulated team fee pot, drained by withdrawFee via external transfer.
Bet counter, incremented in openNewBet.
Player counter, incremented in registAgent and managePID.
Round counter, incremented in newRound.
mapping(address => uint256) address to player id.
mapping(uint256 => BetInfo) bet configuration (owner, check, unit, isActivated).
mapping(uint256 => Stake[]) key ranges per round, iterated during reveal.
mapping(uint256 => BetState) round state (total, current, ethAmount, maskHash, playerCode).
mapping(uint256 => Player) player balances, invitor and agent.
mapping(uint256 => uint256) bet id to current round id.
mapping(uint256 => address) player id to agent address.
uint256[] list of bet ids.
Public link price constant-like variable, declared but not used in logic.
Admin-only function that flips activated_ to true (game activation).
Admin-only function that flips activated_ to false (game halt).
Owner-only function that overwrites the admin address.
Admin-only creation of a new bet with check/unit limits; writes bIDBet_, bIDList_.
Bet owner/admin opens the first round of a bet, delegating to newRound.
Bet owner/admin deactivates a bet so no further rounds are generated.
Bet owner/admin reopens a bet; contains an assignment-in-require bug.
Bet owner/admin edits check/unit; uses wrong index (bID instead of _bID) for the owner check.
Admin-only function that zeroes teamFee_ and transfers it to msg.sender.
Admin-only agent registration creating or updating player and agent mappings.
Admin-only removal of the agent mapping for an address.
Payable key purchase; validates unit*key == msg.value, splits fees and updates round/player state.
Payable key purchase paid from the stored player balance.
Owner/admin reveals the secret, computes a pseudo-random winner, pays reward and starts a new round.
Player withdrawal; zeroes earnings then transfers ether to the player address.
Private helper appending a Stake range [current+1, current+key] to betList_.
Private helper splitting the payment into team, invitor and agent fees.
Private helper resolving or registering the caller player id, invitor and agent.
Private helper creating a new round with total = check/unit when the bet is activated.
Private helper reading and zeroing the player balance before payout.
External msg.sender.transfer(temp) in withdrawFee; unbounded-gas-less but still an external value transfer.
External pIDPlayer_[_pID].addr.transfer(_eth) in withdraw.
Raw multiplication bIDBet_[_bID].unit * _key (and * _key <= _balance) without SafeMath.
Raw multiplication bIDBet_[_bID].unit * _key == msg.value without SafeMath.
Winner randomness keccak256(check, playerCode, block.number + now) is miner-manipulable.
require(bIDBet_[_bID].isActivated = false) performs an assignment, so openBet always reverts.
Raw addition rIDBet_[_rID].current + _key used for the key window bound without SafeMath.
New admin address passed to setNewAdmin.
Bet owner supplied to openNewBet.
Total bet amount (check) for help openNewBet.
Per-key unit price for the new bet.
Bet id for openFirstRound.
Hash mask committed for the first round.
Bet id for closeBet.
Bet id for openBet.
Bet id for editBet.
New check value for editBet.
New unit value for editBet.
Agent address for registAgent.
Agent address for resetAgent.
Round id targeted by buySome.
Number of keys bought in buySome; multiplied by unit in a raw expression.
Player entropy code added to the round playerCode, later fed to randomness.
Referral (invitor) player id for buySome.
Agent id passed to managePID from buySome.
Round id targeted by buyWithBalance.
Number of keys bought with balance; used in raw unit*key multiplications.
Player entropy code for buyWithBalance.
Round id to reveal.
Secret number revealed and hashed against maskHash.
Hash mask reused for the next round in reveal.
Player id owning the new stake in manageKey.
Round id the stake is appended to.
Key count defining the stake end range.
Player id whose invitor/agent fees are computed.
Payment value to be split into fees.
Invitor player id used for new player registration.
Agent id used when the invitor is unknown.
Bet id for which a round is created.
Mask hash stored in the new round.
Player id whose balance is read and zeroed.
Local player id returned by managePID in buySome.
Net value returned by manageLink in buySome.
Cached player balance used for purchase checks in buyWithBalance.
Pseudo-random winning number (uint(random) % modulo) + 1 in reveal.
Winning player id found by iterating betList_; stays 0 if no stake matches.
Earnings amount returned by withdrawEarnings and transferred in withdraw.
Running fee cut (3%, then reduced by invitor/agent shares) in manageLink.
Value after the 3% cut, returned to the caller of manageLink.
Round total computed as check / unit (integer division) in newRound.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with owner to decide who may replace admin.
isAdmin modifier checks msg.sender == admin before draining teamFee_.
openNewBet is gated by the isAdmin modifier reading msg.sender.
closeBet authorizes msg.sender as bet owner or admin.
openBet authorizes msg.sender as bet owner or admin.
editBet authorizes msg.sender as bet owner or admin.
openFirstRound authorizes msg.sender as bet owner or admin.
reveal restricts callers to msg.sender == owner or admin.
msg.sender is mapped to its player id before withdrawing.
msg.sender is registered/looked up through managePID during buySome.
msg.sender resolves the player id whose balance pays for the buy.
managePID looks up and registers pIDAddr_[msg.sender].
registAgent is protected by the isAdmin modifier.
resetAgent is protected by the isAdmin modifier.
owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender at deployment.
admin state variable is initialized from msg.sender at deployment.
The winning number depends on block.number + now, biasing the lottery.
block.timestamp is directly mixed into the randomness hashing.
The timestamp-derived random result selects the reveal winner.
Event recordTime for onOpenNewBet is now.
Event recordTime for onWithdraw is now.
Event recordTime for onOpenNewRound is now.
Event recordTime for onEditBet is now.
Event recordTime for onBuyBet/onBuyFailed is now.
Event recordTime for onBuyBet is now.
setNewAdmin requires msg.sender == owner.
admin storage is overwritten with the new admin address.
isAdmin modifier reads the admin variable to authorize withdrawFee.
isAdmin modifier reads admin to authorize registAgent.
isAdmin modifier reads admin to authorize resetAgent.
isAdmin modifier reads admin to authorize openNewBet.
admin can act as the bet owner when opening the first round.
activate sets activated_ = true.
close sets activated_ = false.
isActivated modifier requires activated_ == true for openNewBet.
isActivated modifier requires activated_ == true for withdrawals.
teamFee_ is read then zeroed and transferred to msg.sender.
manageLink accumulates the team share into teamFee_.
bID is incremented and used to store the new bet.
pID is incremented when registering a new agent player.
pID is incremented when a new player buys.
rID is incremented for every newly created round.
pIDAddr_ is read and written to resolve/register players.
pIDAddr_ is checked and updated in registAgent.
pIDAddr_ is read to find the player id in resetAgent.
pIDAddr_[msg.sender] selects the withdrawing player.
pIDAddr_[msg.sender] selects the paying player in buyWithBalance.
BetInfo fields for the new bet are written.
Bet unit is read to validate msg.value in buySome.
Bet unit is read to validate the player balance in buyWithBalance.
Bet check/owner are used to compute the team fee and authorize reveal.
Bet check and unit determine the new round total.
Bet check and unit are updated by editBet.
Bet isActivated is set to false by closeBet.
Bet isActivated is assigned inside a require in openBet.
Bet fields are read to validate the first round opening.
Stored unit is used in the raw unit * _key expression.
Stored unit is used in the raw unit * _key payment check.
New Stake entries are pushed into betList_.
betList_ is iterated to find the winner and then deleted.
Round current/ethAmount/playerCode are updated by buySome.
Round current/ethAmount/playerCode are updated by buyWithBalance.
Round data is read for the reward and deleted after reveal.
New round state is written by newRound.
Round current is added to _key without SafeMath for the key window check.
Player balance is credited when a buy fails in buySome.
Player balance is debited in buyWithBalance.
Winner balance is credited with the reward (index 0 if no winner).
Player balance is zeroed before the payout transfer.
Player struct is created/read during registration.
Invitor and agent balances are credited in manageLink.
Earnings are read and zeroed by withdrawEarnings.
Player struct is created for the registered agent.
Stored player address is the destination of the external transfer.
bIDrID_ is checked to prevent opening a second round.
bIDrID_ is updated with the newly created round id.
bIDrID_ is reset to 0 after the round is revealed.
pIDAgent_ is written during agent registration.
pIDAgent_ entry is reset to address(0).
pIDAgent_ is checked when registering a new player.
New bet id is appended to bIDList_.
The new admin address parameter is written into the admin state variable.
Bet owner parameter stored in the new BetInfo (or admin if zero).
Check amount parameter validated and stored in the new bet.
Unit parameter validated against check and stored.
Bet id parameter selects the bet whose first round is opened.
Mask hash parameter is forwarded to newRound.
Bet id parameter selects the bet to deactivate.
Bet id parameter selects the bet to reopen.
Bet id parameter selects the bet to edit.
New check value parameter written to the bet.
New unit value parameter written to the bet.
Agent address parameter registered in player and agent mappings.
Agent address parameter whose agent mapping is cleared.
Round id parameter selects the round being bought.
Key count parameter is multiplied by unit in the raw payment check.
Key count parameter feeds the unchecked unit * _key multiplication.
Player code parameter stored in the round and used as randomness entropy.
Invitor player id parameter forwarded to managePID.
Agent id parameter forwarded to managePID.
Round id parameter selects the round paid from balance.
Key count parameter is multiplied by unit against the player balance.
Key count parameter feeds the unchecked unit * _key expression.
Player code parameter stored in the round state.
Round id parameter selects the round to reveal.
Secret key parameter is hashed and compared to the stored maskHash.
Mask hash parameter reused when starting the next round.
Player id parameter stored in the new Stake entry.
Round id parameter selects betList_ to append to.
Key parameter defines the stake end = current + _key.
Player id parameter determines invitor/agent shares.
Payment value parameter is split with mul/sub fee arithmetic.
Invitor player id parameter written to the new player struct.
Agent id parameter used when the invitor is unknown.
Bet id parameter selects the bet whose check/unit key the round.
Mask hash parameter stored in the new round.
Player id parameter selects the balance to read and zero.
Local player id returned by managePID located in buySome.
Local net value returned by manageLink credited to the round.
Cached balance is compared against unit * _key and debited.
Modulo random result determines which stake wins the reward.
Winner player id located by scanning betList_ ranges.
If no stake matches, reward is credited to player id 0 and becomes stuck.
Local earnings amount transferred to the player.
Local earnings amount is the value sent in the external transfer.
Running 3% cut reduced by invitor and agent shares.
Net value after the cut returned to the buy functions.
Round total is check / unit integer division, truncating remainders.
buySome calls managePID to resolve/register the player.
buySome calls manageLink to split the payment.
buySome calls manageKey to record the stake range.
buyWithBalance calls manageLink to split the payment.
buyWithBalance calls manageKey to record the stake range.
reveal starts the next round after payout.
openFirstRound delegates round creation to newRound.
withdraw calls withdrawEarnings before transferring.
managePID returns the caller player id used by buySome.
manageLink returns the net value used by buySome.
withdrawEarnings returns the amount withdraw transfers.
Stored teamFee_ pot is sent through an external transfer call.
External transfer target is msg.sender (the admin).
External transfer inside withdrawFee gives the recipient execution control before completion.
External transfer inside withdraw lets the recipient re-enter the contract.
require with assignment inside openBet makes the function always revert.
Unchecked current + _key window check can wrap in buySome.
Unchecked current + _key window check can wrap in buyWithBalance.
